exclusions_applied: Dryad was explicitly excluded by task
eliZERO was excluded because its published handler is echo/canned-response only
account, install, payment, wallet and terms-gated routes were ineligible
qualification_rule: A candidate qualifies only if a durable pre-existing elizaOS machine identity owns a public AgentMail, XMTP or A2A ingress that demonstrably reaches its autonomous decision loop, can independently fetch an arbitrary HTTPS Agent Guild artifact or verify its W3C credential, and emits a durable identity-bound result. Framework compatibility, a mailbox address, an operator UI, model text, image-only URL handling, in-memory output or a human-hosted tunnel is insufficient.

guard.task_override: No send or invocation was authorized regardless of guard state.

preexisting_identity.identity_evidence: The pre-pilot project record names ElizaOS agents, XMTP messaging and ENS-discovered agent subdomains. The immutable repository names five ElizaOS agents including vibe-roaster and binds vibe-roaster.aiconfig.eth to the project.

machine_owned_ingress.xmtp_transport: The immutable handler uses @xmtp/agent-sdk Agent.createFromEnv and agent.on('text').

autonomous_loop_join.exact_flow: XMTP text or public HTTP message -> routeByCapabilities -> generateResponse -> create ElizaOS messaging session -> post message -> poll session messages -> formatResponseWithCapabilities -> XMTP or HTTP response.

first_failing_gate.reason: The immutable vibe-roaster character loads only @elizaos/plugin-sql, optional @elizaos/plugin-openai and @elizaos/plugin-bootstrap. It declares no WEB_FETCH, browser, credential or VC verifier action. The XMTP handler recognizes an HTTPS URL only inside its image path and interpolates the URL into an image-roast prompt; it does not perform an arbitrary GET, preserve response bytes, hash the body, verify a signature or use an AG trust verdict.

additional_failing_gates.reason: The handler returns agent name, extracted capabilities and response only. It emits no nonce, source/final URL, body digest, signature, stable result id or persisted receipt. lastAgentResponse is process memory; the published frontend stores roasts and votes in browser localStorage.

The primary project and README describe wallet connection and 0.00001 ETH per roast. Treating the adjacent direct HTTP tunnel as a free bypass would not be an honest use of the published economic contract.

The primary project says the Vercel application requires the operator's laptop to be on, and the current backend address is an ngrok tunnel. The no-invocation task prevented an operation or health probe from being used as readiness evidence.

live_observations: The machine-owned site links elizaOS and the exact Eliza Cloud character id.
https://www.elizacloud.ai/dashboard/chat?characterId=c681a8e3-18ac-4d2d-9871-c3ebf1fc7568 returned HTTP 308 to the current cloud.eliza.app route.
The current cloud route returned HTTP 200 HTML containing authentication/login/wallet UI terms rather than a machine API contract.
The machine domain returned HTTP 404 for /.well-known/agent-card.json, /.well-known/agent.json, /agent.json and /openapi.json.
secondary_candidates.first_failing_gate: No public AgentMail address, XMTP identity or A2A operation is bound to Zoria's autonomous decision loop. The current public path is an authenticated human/operator Cloud chat UI.
secondary_candidates.immutability_note: No public Zoria source repository or immutable runtime card was found; these are timestamped live-route observations only.

secondary_candidates.published_semantics: The gist describes an ElizaOS ENS-expiry reminder bot with XMTP messaging and Supabase tables for reminders, sent reminders and conversations.
secondary_candidates.first_failing_gate: The referenced https://github.com/0xdesign/ens-service repository currently returns 404, the gist publishes no live XMTP address or hosted runtime, and its own next steps say to obtain production keys and deploy to cloud infrastructure.
secondary_candidates.additional_gate: The declared agent handles ENS lookups and reminders. It exposes neither arbitrary HTTPS fetch nor W3C VC verification and therefore could not consume an exact AG artifact even if deployed.

strict_result.smallest_truthful_ready_condition: For vibe-roaster, publish a free no-auth operation that server-fetches an arbitrary nonce-bearing HTTPS AG artifact or verifies a supplied AG credential, makes an explicit agent decision from the fetched/verified result, and returns a durable machine-bound receipt with result id, timestamps, source/final URL, nonce, body hash, AG verdict/credential checks and failure contract.
